name: WooCommerce REST API
tagline: REST API for managing products, orders, customers, and store data on WooCommerce sites
description: WooCommerce REST API is a built-in WordPress/WooCommerce interface that lets developers read and write store data (products, orders, customers, coupons, reports) over HTTP. It runs on each merchant's site rather than a single SaaS host, using WordPress authentication (consumer key/secret or OAuth 1.0a) and JSON responses. Official docs cover endpoints, authentication, and versioning for WooCommerce 3.5+.

auth.details: Consumer key and secret generated in WooCommerce > Settings > Advanced > REST API; use HTTP Basic Auth over HTTPS (key as username, secret as password) or OAuth 1.0a on HTTP.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Included free with WooCommerce (open-source plugin); no per-request API fees from WooCommerce
pricing.paid_plans: WooCommerce core is free; hosting and optional WooCommerce.com extensions may be paid separately

rate_limits: Not published by WooCommerce; limited by the WordPress/host server configuration
use_cases: list or create WooCommerce products for a store
fetch and update orders and order status
create coupons and apply discount rules
pull sales reports and store analytics
sync inventory stock levels across systems
